snippet.title: Till Midnight | Official Teaser (30 secs)
snippet.description:
After over a year in the deep, Team Take Me Out and Team StaccWars are proud to unveil the first official teaser for Till Midnight, a management simulation game inspired by true historical events.

𝘚𝘺𝘯𝘰𝘱𝘴𝘪𝘴:

You play as a commanding officer navigating a darkly atmospheric submarine amid critical communication failures.

Trapped hundreds of meters below the surface, your only companion is the state-built artificial intelligence known as A.R.K (Atomic Response Kernel). A.R.K serves as both your advisor and second-in-command, but in the end, the final decision rests in your hands.

In the depths, enemies converge, and hesitation sows downfall...

From Team Take Me Out, an indie collective of storytellers, artists and makers driven by emotional narrative, innovative gameplay and atmospheric immersion.

Play the game and follow our journey:
► Website: tmo-dev.itch.io/till-midnight

#tillmidnightgame #indiegame #submarinelife #narrativegame #gamedev #gameart #gamedesign
